title: How to use Day Planner
summary: Schedule tasks by placing them on a daily calendar.

blocks.heading: Plan the day
paragraphs: Day Planner places unscheduled tasks beside a daily calendar. Drag a task from the Planner list into a time slot to reserve time for it.
Use Group to organize the task list and the date arrows to move between days.

blocks.caption: The live Day Planner
blocks.alt: The Day Planner with an unscheduled task list and daily calendar
